title: Closest Shared Boss
statement:
A company is a tree with `n` employees numbered `1..n`; employee `1` is the boss of everyone, and every other employee `i` has a direct manager `p_i`. For two employees, their closest shared boss is the lowest employee who is a manager (direct or indirect) of both, where an employee counts as a manager of themselves.

You get `q` queries, each with two employees. To keep the output short, print the sum of the closest shared bosses' numbers over all queries.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `q`. The second line contains `p_2 ... p_n` (it is absent when `n = 1`). Then `q` lines follow, each with two employees `u` and `v`.

## Output
Print the sum of the numbers of the closest shared bosses.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 12000`
- `1 <= q <= 8000`
- The managers form a tree rooted at employee `1`.
